generations.prompt: Cinderhound, a stocky volcanic hound monster for a JRPG side-view battle, standing on four legs in side view, facing right. Ash-grey stone-like hide with darker brown-grey belly and legs, a row of jagged glowing orange-ember crystal spikes along its back, ember-tipped tail at the left, blunt snout with a small ember eye at the right, short sturdy legs. Idle stance. Clean readable pixel art sprite with dark outline, single creature centred, feet at the bottom, transparent background.
idle breathing loop: body rises and falls slightly, ember back spikes flicker, tail sways a little, feet stay planted in place
bite attack: crouches back on its haunches to wind up, then lunges forward to the right with jaws snapping open, then returns to its standing pose
casting a fire spell: plants its feet, raises its head and howls, the ember spikes on its back flare bright and a small burst of ember sparks rises from them, then settles back
taking a hit: flinches backwards to the left, head jerks back, eyes squeeze shut, body recoils and lowers, then recovers to standing
death: staggers, legs buckle and it collapses onto its side on the ground, the ember spikes dim and go dark, it crumbles into a low pile of grey ash and cooling embers
